changeReasons.reason: Restrict component-deferral evidence reads to composed-route paths and the existing correction-assignment record to prevent whole-repository tracing. The terminal-treatment loader and bundle projection serving SC are unchanged.

Literal release-readiness and problematic-PDF JSON paths replace indirect filesystem reads; add technical reconstruction for already-claimed workers with UNFINISHED availability. Both application and claimed-worker paths preserve SC suppression and renderer none.

Add direct-artifact storage-path helper and correct ownerNamespace naming; select claimed-worker resolver only for claimed-worker purpose. Existing application path and first refusal for exact-supported deferral remain unchanged; claimed workers also receive no SC spec.

Checkout catalog/promotion/reconciliation, classified provider failures, render preflight, server-readiness presentation, compare-and-swap stored-session recovery, and partner-sponsorship guard changes. SC payment-placeholder and typed terminal-treatment checkout refusal remain unchanged. Added readiness still calls that refusal before preflight or new Stripe session; historical paid-order recovery grants no new commercial or artifact authority.

limitations: Pure runtime gates and preserved EN/ES projection replay; no live provider, database, authenticated UI, new legal or human language approval.
